title: Charger
drDigitalIntro:
The charger is your laptop's power cord.
• One end plugs into the wall and the other end plugs into the side of your laptop.
• When it is plugged in, a small light on the charger or a lightning bolt on the battery icon tells you it is charging.
• It is safe to leave the charger plugged in all the time — modern laptops stop drawing power once the battery is full.
• Always hold the plug itself when pulling the charger out. Yanking by the cable can damage the wire over time.
• Most modern laptops charge through a USB-C cable, which looks like a small oval plug.

media.alt: A USB charging cable with plug connectors on both ends
media.caption: This is what a laptop charger looks like.

drDigitalSuccess: That's your charger! Keep it nearby so your laptop never runs out of battery.
drDigitalHint: Take a look at your charger, then click Continue whenever you're ready.
